entries.proposition: Spasms ceased after clobazam was added to valproate.
entries.snippet: Following the addition of clobazam, the spasms completely subsided

entries.proposition: At 4 months, seizure-free for one month; hypokinetic features persisted.

entries.proposition: Parents not consanguineous by report but from the same village.
entries.snippet: Although parental consanguinity was not present, both parents were from the same village.
